gitCommit.subject: fix/screen size testing workflow (#695)
gitCommit.body:
fix/screen size testing workflow (#695)

* fix: screen size testing workflow deploy and artifact upload

- Change github_token to personal_token for peaceiris/actions-gh-pages
  external repository deployment (github_token cannot push to external repos)
- Add separate test results artifact upload step matching nightly workflow
  pattern (uploads test-results-screen-sizes/ and screen-size-report/)

* fix: gracefully handle missing auth-state.json in screen size tests

- Use getOptionalAuthState() instead of hardcoded path in both
  screen-sizes.config.ts and screen-sizes-fast.config.ts (matching
  the nightly config pattern)
- Write fallback empty auth state file in global-setup-ci.ts when
  credentials are missing or auth fails, preventing ENOENT crashes
